caseName: Lordmaster v. Dist. Court of N. Dakota
caseNameFull: Frankie Jae LORDMASTER, fka Jason Robert Goldader v. DISTRICT COURT OF NORTH DAKOTA, CASS COUNTY.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and the petition for a writ of certiorari dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
